source_contract.input_limit: Released design shell overrides max_seq_len=512. Overlength token IDs are prefix-cropped to512, decoded with tokenizer_pred, and then tokenized again with truncation. This is a token cap, not a character or residue count.
source_contract.target_and_generation_limit: Released shell overrides max_target_len=256. Label tokenization truncates to256; predict passes max_length=256 to model.generate. This is not a guaranteed256-residue output. Source also sets model.max_new_tokens from a default empty-string field, but generate receives an explicit max_length and no max_new_tokens argument.
source_contract.protein_token_inventory:
Input tokenizer adds20 standard-amino-acid tokens of the form

{letter} as special tokens, plus / boundaries. Generic pretraining code forms boundary-wrapped per-residue-prefixed strings; this is not evidence of the unopened design artifact encoding.
source_contract.prediction_tokenizer: get_tokenizer_pred recreates added token IDs from32100 onward with special_tokens=False and asserts complete vocabulary ID identity. main.py passes this prediction tokenizer to predict.
source_contract.decode: Prediction, labels, and inputs are batch-decoded with skip_special_tokens=True and clean_up_tokenization_spaces=True, then stripped. Because added protein tokens are nonspecial in tokenizer_pred, this path does not automatically erase them. No additional protein-string cleanup occurs in molinst_pro_understand.

upstream_MEAN.default_components: Heavy chain, light chain and antigen interface context (mode111).
upstream_MEAN.sequence_and_structure: Dataset tensors contain residue identities and N/CA/C/O coordinates with heavy-chain CDR labels. Antibody chains are variable-region spans under the source IMGT mapping; not arbitrary full mature-protein chains.
upstream_MEAN.numbering: Preparation requests IMGT/pre-numbered structures. AAComplex maps heavy/light CDR1 27-38, CDR2 56-65, CDR3 105-117, with insertions retained by residue-number mapping; exact resulting case boundaries require actual source structures and processing.
upstream_MEAN.target_masking: The selected model cdr_type determines a fixed labeled heavy-chain target span. init_mask replaces target sequence IDs and overwrites target coordinates with interpolation between its flanking residues; framework and non-target CDR context stay present. The checked-in wrapper defaults to CDR3.
upstream_MEAN.target_gold_separation: Model source saves true target sequence/coordinates for evaluation before masking. A future solver request must receive the masked representation, while native target identities/coordinates remain scorer-side.
upstream_MEAN.antigen_context: Dataset uses interface_only=True. AAComplex selects up to48 antigen residues globally by smallest minimum C-alpha distance to either antibody chain; these selected residues are included with residue identities and backbone coordinates. This is structure-derived native context, not an optional name-only antigen label.
upstream_MEAN.selection_context_constraint: Dropping the light chain, antigen interface or coordinates would define an adapted input condition and cannot be reported as faithful native reproduction.

upstream_MEAN_AAR.unit: One selected CDR of one antibody-antigen complex.
upstream_MEAN_AAR.matching: Case-sensitive positional equality through Python zip(native_CDR, generated_CDR); no sequence alignment or fuzzy matching.
upstream_MEAN_AAR.denominator: Full native CDR length, not generated length or zipped length.

length_handling.short_prediction: Unpaired native positions reduce AAR because denominator stays full native length.

length_handling.full_evaluator_constraint: The full eval_one also consumes generated 3D coordinates and computes RMSD/TM-score; it is not a standalone text-only AAR evaluator.

upstream_MEAN_AAR.aggregation: Unweighted arithmetic mean of per-complex AAR values, extended across retained candidate slots if topk>1; not residue-pooled recovery.
